summary: Tshela territory (Kongo-Central, Mayombe forest region bordering Angola's Cabinda enclave) comprises Tshela town, the secondary centres of Loango (Quartier Rail, on the former Boma-Tshela railway) and Tsanga Nord/Kuimba, and rural villages of the Vaku, Kuimba, Kizu, Kinkonzi and Tshela secteurs. No armed group is known to hold territory here; the area is far from the eastern conflict zones. The PNC, with the territorial administration and customary chiefs, handles order, arrests and disputes, with FARDC and border/migration services present near the Angolan (Cabinda) border. Security issues are crime, land and customary disputes, sporadic Bundu dia Kongo-related unrest in earlier years and occasional cross-border incidents, none of which displaced state control. Web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted), so the assessment rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Tshela town (territorial chef-lieu), Loango/Quartier Rail and Tsanga Nord (Kuimba) centres
zones.evidence: Territorial headquarters and secondary trading centres with no reported armed-group control; PNC commissariats handle policing and detention, with FARDC elements stationed in the territory. No sources could be retrieved in this run.
